description: Defines the SSLClientSessionCache class and related structures for managing SSL client session caching, including session lookup, insertion, expiration, and cache management functions.

classes.name: SSLClientSessionCache
classes.description: Manages SSL client session cache with operations for lookup, insert, expiration, and cache management.

classes.name: SSLClientSessionCache::Config
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the session cache, including max entries and expiration check count.

classes.name: SSLClientSessionCache::Key
classes.description: Represents a unique key for cache entries, including server info, IP address, network key, privacy mode, and crypto settings.

classes.name: SSLClientSessionCache::Entry
classes.description: Internal structure holding up to two SSL sessions for cache entries.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache::IsExpired
methods.description: Checks if a given SSL session is expired based on current time.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache::size
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the cache.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache::Lookup
methods.description: Retrieves a session associated with a cache key, moving it to the MRU position.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache::Insert
methods.description: Inserts a session into the cache with a specific key.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache::ClearEarlyData
methods.description: Clears early data support for sessions associated with a cache key.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache::FlushForServer
methods.description: Removes all cache entries for a specific server.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache::Flush
methods.description: Clears all entries from the cache.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache::SetClockForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom clock for testing purposes.
